verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a workflow-automation platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an Activepieces CLI. The one-line install script (curl | sh), the REST API with API keys, the embedding SDK and the MCP server are an installer, an API or adjacent features, not an official command-line tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
